scope: Primary-source buy and installation research for eight material and equipment families in guide.json. Quantities based on unverified room dimensions remain estimating quantities until the named field gates are closed.
authority_boundary: Manufacturer literature governs the listed products. The architect, engineer, licensed trades, code official, and fabricators govern project-specific supports, wiring, fire assemblies, overhead retention, and substrate suitability. No anchor capacity or code approval is inferred here.

known_dimensions_and_constraints: Appliance: 15 W x 23.375 D x 33.875-34.875 H inches.
Cabinet opening: at least 15.125 W x 34 H inches.
Allow at least 1 inch behind the unit for the electrical plug and 2.25 inches at the hinge side when next to a wall.
Keep the front ventilation grille unobstructed and preserve pull-out service access.
A 23.375-inch body plus the 1-inch rear plug clearance needs 24.375 inches before finish tolerance, so a nominal 24-inch flush cabinet is not a verified fit.
install_sequence: Choose door hinge side and handle before the cabinet shop drawing; verify adjacent wall and door swing.
Show the exact opening, rear plug space, receptacle location, ventilation grille, finished floor buildup, face projection, and removal path on the millworker/electrical shop drawing.
Complete floor and cabinet work, provide the accessible grounded receptacle required by the current manual, and inspect the opening before delivery.
Level the appliance, attach the selected handle, slide it in without pinching the cord, and confirm the front vent is open.
Test door swing, lock, shelves, temperature controls, lighting, alarm, and removal access before turnover.
field_holds: Do not fabricate the bar at a nominal 24-inch flush depth without an approved recess, deeper casework, or intentional appliance projection.
Do not enclose the front grille or place fixed trim where it blocks appliance removal.
Verify current electrical requirements from the manual and local code with the electrician.

source_families.selection_status: candidate system; components verified, run schedule and curved-arch detail unresolved

buy.item: BLAZE 100 24V 2700K 90+ CRI tape
buy.quantity_basis: net measured runs plus cut/joint allowance after the feed schedule; do not buy only from the current global linear-foot total
buy.release: after field measurement and segmented run schedule

buy.item: 96-inch black S1 channel bundle with classic frosted lens
buy.quantity_basis: shop-drawing takeoff by straight segment, with waste and spare lenses
buy.included_or_extra: manufacturer describes channel bundles as complete with accessories; confirm bundle contents on the supplier quote
buy.release: straight millwork and surface-mounted runs only unless Diode approves the curved detail

buy.item: black S1 accessory pack
buy.quantity_basis: per joint/end/feed schedule
buy.release: supplier to reconcile with what each channel bundle includes

buy.item: OMNIDRIVE Basics 24V 96W Class 2 driver
buy.quantity_basis: one or more per zone based on calculated connected load, conductor length, voltage drop, and accessible locations
buy.included_or_extra: driver with listed junction-box form factor
buy.release: after signed electrical load schedule

buy.item: Diode-compatible tape-to-wire connectors or soldered factory leads, Class 2 low-voltage wire, feeds, junctions, and dimmers
buy.quantity_basis: per run and control schedule
buy.included_or_extra: extras; electrician and Diode distributor select exact parts
buy.release: after bench test and wire/voltage-drop design

known_dimensions_and_constraints: BLAZE 100 selection is 1.46 W/ft, 113 lm/ft, 3.93-inch cut points, and a 55-foot maximum run from one feed.
OMNIDRIVE DI-ODBELV-24V96W-LPS is 24V, 96W, Class 2, IP20, no minimum load, and manufacturer-listed to dim to 5 percent; it is not a blanket approval for every control/load combination.
S1 is a low-profile straight aluminum channel for millwork or surface mounting. The arch heads need a separately approved flexible or segmented detail.
The approximately 71.76-foot room perimeter cannot be treated as one 55-foot BLAZE feed even if total wattage appears acceptable.
Drivers and junctions must remain accessible and adequately ventilated.
install_sequence: Field-measure each lighting path and issue a zone-by-zone schedule showing segment length, cut points, feed end, connected watts, driver, wire route, voltage drop, control, and service access.

Build and approve a full system mockup using the exact tape, channel/lens, driver, dimmer, lead length, and representative dark finishes; test low-end dimming, flicker, camera behavior, heat, and color.
Rough in line voltage, accessible driver/junction locations, Class 2 conductors, neutrals required by the selected controls, and separated feeds while walls and millwork are open.
Dry-fit channels, end conditions, lenses, joints, and feed holes; cut straight channels cleanly and resolve the arch curve with a manufacturer-approved detail before finish work.
Clean the channel, cut tape only at marked cut points, make polarity-correct listed connections, and test every segment before closing the lens.
Commission each zone at full and minimum output; label drivers, circuits, zones, and service panels; record installed run lengths and loads.
field_holds: Licensed electrician and lighting supplier must approve the line-voltage, Class 2, dimmer, and conductor design.
Do not conceal drivers or junction boxes behind non-removable mirrors, fabric, or millwork.
Do not bend straight S1 channel around arch heads or exceed tape bend/run limits without written manufacturer approval.
The current brief contains a DMX-versus-wall-dimmer control decision; resolve protocol before ordering drivers and controls.

source_families.recommendation: Karndean Van Gogh Rigid Core Ebony SCB89 for the main floor, paired under the large furniture-anchored lounge rug with a custom-cut RugPadUSA Eco-Plush 1/4-inch all-felt pad. Preserve the booth-floor decision as a separate field-confirmed scope.
source_families.selection_status: floor and pad candidates; samples, existing-floor demolition, substrate, and finished buildup unresolved

buy.item: Karndean Van Gogh Rigid Core Ebony planks, 48 x 7 x 0.177 inches
buy.quantity_basis: current estimate: 14 cartons x 23.64 sq ft = 330.96 sq ft for a 328.63 sq ft allowance; recalculate after field survey and layout
buy.release: after substrate/moisture/flatness survey and sample approval

buy.item: threshold, reducer, edge, and skirting profiles
buy.quantity_basis: field-measured openings and transitions
buy.release: after finished floor elevations and door clearances are known

buy.item: RugPadUSA 100 percent heat-pressed felt rug pad
buy.quantity_basis: custom-cut for the approved rug; manufacturer examples finish 2 inches shorter in each overall dimension
buy.included_or_extra: separate rug pad; no grip layer
buy.release: only for a large rug securely anchored by furniture

known_dimensions_and_constraints: SCB89 is 4.5 mm thick with a 20 mil wear layer and 23.64 sq ft per carton.
Karndean requires removal of laminate, floating floors, and cushion-backed floors; identify whether the existing oak LVP is floating or adhered before pricing demolition.
Substrate must be solid, sound, smooth, clean, and level; Karndean limits unevenness to 3/16 inch over 10 feet.
Karndean calls for concrete moisture testing and wood moisture at or below 13 percent; the installer must use the current guide and record results.
Fixed cabinets and permanent fixtures go in before the floating floor, with the required expansion space maintained around them.

Karndean warns against rubber-backed mats. Eco-Plush is 100 percent felt and intended for larger rugs that do not require non-slip grip, but final floor compatibility remains subject to Karndean's warranty requirements.
install_sequence: Approve full-size floor and rug/pad samples under the actual 2700K lighting, then verify carton batch and rug-pad compatibility in writing.
Survey room area, plank direction, thresholds, doors, fixed millwork, booth transition, flatness, moisture, and existing LVP construction; issue a demolition and transition plan.
Remove incompatible floating/cushioned flooring, repair and clean the substrate, document flatness and moisture, and acclimate/store material exactly as the current Karndean guide requires.

Install fixed bar/cabinet bases before the floating floor. Lay SCB89 with manufacturer-required expansion spaces, stagger, cutting, and locking procedure; do not pin the floor beneath fixed construction.
Fit transitions and skirting without trapping the floating field, protect the floor during remaining work, and retain labeled spare planks/carton information.

After cure/cleaning and furniture placement, install the custom-cut felt pad beneath the approved large rug with no pad exposed and with the rug held by furniture; check edges for trip or roll hazards.
field_holds: Do not order from the 14-carton estimate until field area, layout waste, batch availability, and spare stock are reconciled.
Do not install SCB89 over an existing floating LVP.
Do not add a separate underlay unless Karndean approves the exact assembly in writing.
Do not use Eco-Plush under a small/mobile rug; it has no non-slip layer. Confirm that the approved lounge rug is held by heavy furniture and that the pad does not affect the flooring warranty.

buy.quantity_basis: dealer takeoff by panel/elevation, seam plan, direction, and matching dye lot, plus waste and repair stock
buy.release: after sample, dye lot, track/core, and assembly approvals

buy.sku: GeoTRAK Black, profile depth to be selected

buy.quantity_basis: authorized dealer takeoff; 1/2, 1, and 1-3/8-inch profile depths are available
buy.included_or_extra: retention profiles only; core, perimeter details, substrate prep, and labor are separate

buy.quantity_basis: installer takeoff for two nominal 102-inch-high returns plus approved top/bottom joint or taller-product detail
buy.release: after field dimensions, joint detail, and sample approval

buy.sku: WoodUpp black installation screws, 100-pack, or project-approved equivalent
buy.item: visible black panel screws
buy.quantity_basis: manufacturer indicates about 15 screws per panel for direct-to-wall installation; expanded assemblies require the approved batten/fastener schedule
buy.release: installer selects fastener for verified substrate and assembly

known_dimensions_and_constraints: FR701 is 100 percent post-consumer recycled polyester with 66-inch usable width, no backing, no added treatment, and no repeat. Manufacturer component results do not prove the finished wall assembly.
GeoTRAK is site-built and dealer-installed. The exact profile, acoustic core, fabric, edge, outlet, HVAC, service-access, and junction details must be submitted as one assembly.
WoodUpp's Class A statement is an acoustic absorption class when installed with 45 mm battens and insulation, not a fire-class claim.
The 94.49-inch WoodUpp panel is 7.51 inches short of the nominal 102-inch return height.
Acoustic finish and slat panels are not structural backing for TV or instrument hangers.
install_sequence: Field-survey retained acoustic construction, solid wall areas, door/trim transitions, outlets, HVAC, lighting, TV/hanger backing, and service panels; do not remove existing absorptive work until the acoustician approves the scope.
Produce coordinated elevations showing GeoTRAK perimeter/profile depth, core, seams, FR701 direction, removable access, WoodUpp joints/cuts, blocking penetrations, and transition to plaster/paint.
Approve physical FR701, WoodUpp, and edge/junction samples under room lighting; reserve one FR701 dye lot and matching WoodUpp batch.
Install and inspect structural backing, rough-ins, substrate prep, and any batten/core work before covering. Keep structural attachments independent of finish panels.

Install GeoTRAK/core and tuck FR701 with controlled tension and clean corners; install WoodUpp per the approved direct-wall or expanded batten detail, re-securing cut slat ends to felt as directed by WoodUpp.
Finish outlets, returns, transitions, and removable access; photograph concealed backing and retain labeled fabric/panel repair stock.
field_holds: A qualified FabriTRAK dealer must provide the assembly and current test documentation; component fire/acoustic data cannot be added together as an assembly rating.
Acoustician must approve retained cores, replacement cores, and coverage before demolition or fabrication.
Resolve the 7.51-inch WoodUpp height gap with an approved joint, base/header, or taller product; do not stretch the panel dimensions.
TV and instrument fasteners must land in verified independent backing, not felt, slats, fabric track, or acoustic core.

buy.quantity_basis: 6 main-room fixtures per current guide; booth quantity/product separately confirmed

buy.quantity_basis: 4 heads

buy.item: black live-end/feed connector and end cap, plus junction/support hardware
buy.quantity_basis: one coordinated set
buy.release: electrician selects exact connector from actual feed side and ceiling junction; do not guess the feed SKU

known_dimensions_and_constraints: NM4-RDC27BB: 15W, 1027 delivered lumens, 2700K, 90+ CRI, 37-degree narrow flood, 3.5-inch cutout, 4.5-inch trim, 4.875-inch height, Triac/ELV dimming to 10 percent.
Nora lists the module IC airtight and wet-location rated but excludes direct contact with spray-foam insulation; maximum listed module-to-driver separation is 40 feet.
HT4-BK is a 4-foot, 120V, single-circuit H-style track. WAC lists 1920W maximum for the track; four selected 20W heads total 80W nominal.
H-2020-927-BK is 2700K/90 CRI and provides 715 lumens at 15 degrees to 985 lumens at 50 degrees per WAC's table.
Track polarity and contact orientation matter; follow the grooved-side instructions for the live end and heads.
install_sequence: Issue a reflected-ceiling/photometric plan with exact downlight centers, mirror conflict zones, track/feed position, circuits, controls, ceiling depths, structure, insulation, and driver/junction access.
Mock up one downlight and one track head against black finishes at 2700K; test dimming, flicker/camera behavior, beam spread, TV/mirror glare, instrument highlights, and seated sightlines.
Licensed electrician turns power off, verifies ceiling cavities and structure, provides boxes/wiring/controls, and installs any required frames before closing the ceiling.
Use the Nora cut template only after scanning each location; connect the driver/J-box, keep it accessible, and seat the module with its spring clips without contact with prohibited insulation.

Install and support WAC H Track with the live end on the correct polarity side, fit the end cap, insert heads with contacts oriented to the grooved side, rotate/lock each head, and verify secure engagement.
After TV and instruments are installed, aim and set beam angles; commission each control zone at full and minimum output and label circuits/components.
field_holds: Do not cut the ceiling until cavity, structure, insulation, mirror support, and services are scanned and the reflected-ceiling plan is approved.
Do not assume the older NMF-3 frame reference is current; have Nora/distributor confirm the exact frame/accessory for NM4-RDC27BB.
Do not aim track heads until the final TV and full-size instruments are installed; glare and heat on finishes require a real mockup.
The electrician selects track fasteners and feed components for verified structure and junction geometry; no support capacity is inferred here.

source_families.selection_status: candidate hanger family; instrument-by-instrument fit and field elevation unresolved

buy.item: Hardwood wall-mount Guitar Keeper with pivoting padded yoke
buy.quantity_basis: one per inventoried instrument that passes the weight, neck, headstock, finish, and removal-clearance mockup
buy.included_or_extra: String Swing lists mounting hardware as included, but project fasteners may need replacement for the verified wall/backing assembly
buy.release: after full-size TV/instrument elevation and backing inspection

buy.sku: CC01 or compatible replacement yoke selected by String Swing
buy.item: wider-neck yoke option
buy.quantity_basis: per measured classical guitar/bass that does not fit CC01K
buy.release: assign per actual instrument; do not substitute by visual guess

buy.item: structural blocking/backing, finish spacers if required, and substrate-compatible fasteners
buy.quantity_basis: carpenter/installer shop drawing
buy.release: after wall investigation and full-size mockup

known_dimensions_and_constraints: String Swing rates CC01K for instruments up to 15 pounds and directs wider classical/bass necks to the original CC01 yoke rather than assuming one yoke fits all.
CC01K removal requires lifting the instrument approximately 2 inches before moving it forward; the field elevation also needs full headstock, body, TV, speaker, ceiling, and hand clearance.
String Swing says the padding does not eat nitrocellulose, but prolonged pressure and under-cured nitro can still mark; record each instrument finish and inspect contact points.
Finish slats, fabric track, and acoustic core are not structural backing.
The design brief targets ten display positions, while its inventory lists six instruments. Confirm the physical collection and remaining positions in the field-fit elevation.
install_sequence: Inventory every instrument: model, overall width/height/depth, weight, neck width at the yoke, headstock shape, finish, strap hardware, and removal arc.
Template the actual TV, speakers, track-light beams, each full-size instrument, yoke center, required 2-inch lift, and hand/body clearance on the wall elevation.
Open or scan the wall, locate structure/services, and issue a backing/fastener drawing coordinated with fabric/slat finish thickness and removable access.
Install and photograph backing before finishes close; then transfer verified centers through the finished wall without relying on felt, slats, or fabric track.
Mount each block level with installer-selected fasteners into verified backing, fit the correct CC01K/CC01 yoke, and hand-check engagement before loading.
Load one instrument at a time, test pivot, lift/removal, finish contact, TV/speaker clearance, and headstock/ceiling clearance; label or document each assigned position.
field_holds: Do not order one yoke type for every instrument until neck and headstock geometry are measured.
Do not reuse supplied drywall anchors; String Swing's instructions expressly warn against anchor reuse, and this project should use verified backing with compatible new fasteners.
Do not shrink instrument envelopes or claim all six fit until Greg approves the full-size field mockup.
Installer/engineer selects fasteners and backing from actual substrate and loads; no anchor capacity is specified here.

buy.sku: N522, color Black 2132-10 or approved sampled black

buy.item: Scuff-X Interior Matte optional high-touch coating

known_dimensions_and_constraints: Aura N522 matte is listed at 3-5 gloss units at 85 degrees and a theoretical 350-400 sq ft/gal spread rate at 4.3 mil wet/2.1 mil dry.
The TDS lists approximately 1-hour touch and recoat at 77 F/50 percent RH, and states painted surfaces may be washed after two weeks; actual drying varies with conditions.
Manufacturer application temperature is 50-90 F; substrate must be clean, dry, sound, and properly prepared/primed.
Black color and sheen must be judged under the actual 2700K lighting. Paint stays off acoustic fabric, equipment, labels, mirror edges, and service components.
install_sequence: Create a finish schedule separating solid plaster/drywall, ceiling, trim, doors, fabric/acoustic surfaces, slat panels, and items that remain unpainted.
Build large sample boards with the intended primer and two finish coats of shortlisted blacks; review at full and minimum 2700K lighting beside mirror, fabric, slat, floor, and furniture samples.

Complete rough-ins and patching; protect acoustic materials/equipment; clean, repair, sand, and dust substrates; test adhesion and isolate stains or incompatible coatings with the manufacturer-recommended primer.
Apply primer and finish at the TDS spread/recoat conditions, maintaining a consistent batch and wet edge; inspect black surfaces with grazing light before final coat.
Allow full cure before adhesive-backed finishes, mirrors, hardware, cleaning, or abrasion; record color formula, product, sheen, batch, and touch-up stock.
field_holds: Painter must select primer and prep from the actual substrate and coating condition; no universal primer is specified.
Do not paint absorptive fabric/core, labels, ventilation openings, electrical hardware, or mirror bonding/retention surfaces unless their manufacturer approves it.
Do not release the whole-room color from a fan deck chip; approve a representative large-area 2700K mockup.

Use only backing, setting materials, and mirror adhesive that the mirror fabricator confirms are chemically compatible with the selected mirror backing.
source_families.selection_status: sample candidate only; glass type/build-up, modules, retention, support, weight, and edge details unresolved

buy.sku: Omega sample set: Dark Cloud Antique, Smoky Quartz Mirror, Gold Vein Overlay Mirror
buy.item: physical decorative mirror samples
buy.quantity_basis: one reviewed set plus illuminated full-size mockup
buy.release: now for comparison; no fabrication release

buy.item: five field-templated wall mirror arches with approved mirror/glass build-up, edge finish, safety backing or lamination, pattern orientation, and mechanical retention
buy.quantity_basis: 5 panels/modules per approved shop drawing; current 24-inch-wide arch coordinates are design intent, not cut sizes
buy.release: after M-03, M-07, M-12 and signed glazier shop drawing

buy.item: nominal 96 x 96-inch ceiling mirror visual zone, divided into support-designer-approved modules with safety build-up, perimeter/intermediate mechanical capture, and removable service access
buy.quantity_basis: one coordinated assembly
buy.release: after verified structure, total/panel weight, support calculations, code/seismic requirements, and signed shop drawing

buy.item: sealed/primed substrate, soft setting blocks/spacers, perimeter J-channel/frame/clips or other mechanical capture, safety backing/lamination, and mirror-rated neutral-cure sealant or mastic if used
buy.quantity_basis: glazier/support-designer takeoff
buy.included_or_extra: installation materials; exact brands/SKUs require compatibility submittal
buy.release: as one tested/approved assembly, not independent substitutions

known_dimensions_and_constraints: Omega's listed patterns are handcrafted and vary; physical sample and pattern layout approval are essential.
Walker Glass warns that support surfaces must be dry, stable, smooth, sealed/primed as appropriate, and cured before mirror installation; mirror should be installed late in the project.

Mechanical retention methods include J moulding/channel, clips, screws, or frames with setting blocks/spacers. Adhesive, if used, must be specifically compatible with the mirror backing and applied to allow ventilation/cure.
Walker reports manufacturer guidance favoring panel widths no greater than 48 inches; the support designer and fabricator must set actual module sizes.
Adhesive alone is not a released detail for the ceiling mirror.
install_sequence: Approve Omega samples and an illuminated mockup showing antique pattern, gold veining, black backing/frame, edge appearance, LED separation, and reflection under actual room lighting.
Field-template every wall arch and survey the ceiling plane, supports, deflection, services, access, LED channels, clearances, and installation path.

Glazier/support designer submits panel/module drawings, glass/mirror type and thickness, pattern orientation, safety backing/lamination, panel and total weights, edge treatment, sealed substrate, soft setting blocks, mechanical retention, adhesive compatibility if any, service access, and replacement method.
Complete and inspect structural supports, blocking, wiring, channels, substrate sealing/curing, and dry conditions before glass delivery; confirm storage and handling plan.

Install setting blocks/spacers and mechanical capture, place panels without edge damage or hard-point contact, apply only approved mirror-compatible adhesive/sealant in the approved pattern, and keep required ventilation/drainage/service paths.
Inspect retention, joints, edges, reflections, LED hot spots, access, and panel identification; retain templates, shop drawings, approved products, and replacement information.
field_holds: Wall-arch coordinates and nominal 96 x 96 ceiling zone are design intent, not fabrication cut sizes.
